summary: Stove-edge cookpot placement and reach-across scraping create burn and scald risks.

hazards.title: Large pot at cooktop edge
hazards.detail: Tall stockpot sits near front grates, risking hot liquid spills or tip-overs.
fixSteps: Move heavy stockpots to rear burners whenever feasible.
Keep handles oriented inward away from the cooktop perimeter.

hazards.title: Reaching over open hot pot
hazards.detail: Scraping ingredients into pot while reaching directly over rim creates steam burn risk.
fixSteps: Lower the cutting board close to the rim to prevent splashback.
Angle hands and body clear of escaping steam.

hazards.title: Accessible front range dials
hazards.detail: Front-mounted stove control knobs are easily turned by young children.
fixSteps: Install clear safety knob covers over front burner controls.
Remove removable burner knobs when the range is unattended.

products.name: Stove Knob Safety Covers
products.reason: Prevents accidental activation of gas cooktop burners.

products.name: Cooktop Stove Guard
products.reason: Blocks children and accidental bumps from tipping hot pots.
